scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Through the power
of holiness, may we
find peace, strength
and protection. Deliver
us from the forces of evil...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
愿神圣之力赐予我们和平、力量与庇护。将我们从邪恶势力中拯救出来……

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Our world is in
need of people of
talent and conviction.
Please continue your
good works as an even
greater hero of holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
我们的世界需要既有才华又有信念的人。请继续努力，成为更伟大的神圣英雄……

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Would you like
to become a High Priest?
scripts.translation:
[神官]
你想转职为神官吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
当你准备好时，随时可以回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。在回到我这里之前，请使用完所有剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
As a High Priest,
I hope you will guide
others upon the path
to holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
作为一名神官，
我希望你能引导
他人走上神圣之路……

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣誉殿堂。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
请在这里
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
